name: Adrian Popescu
bio:
Adrian's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in his grandfather's small mechanics shop in rural Romania. He spent his youth disassembling and reassembling engines, developing an intimate understanding of how machines work. He transitioned to a technical role with a regional rally team before proving his aptitude for management. 

As Head of Operations for Caterham Academy, Adrian blends his technical expertise with a focus on process optimization and strategic planning. He believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and empowers his team to think creatively, constantly seeking marginal gains in every aspect of the operation. His passion lies in finding innovative solutions to complex problems, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible with available resources.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Adrian is of average height with a focused, intense gaze, often seen with grease under his fingernails even in formal settings.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and ideas.
Has a habit of pacing when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting every car before a race.
